name: Basic coding
description: Repository access, package acquisition and the selected model API as separate modules for a protected coding session.

modules.name: Repository access (GitHub)
modules.rationale: git fetch/push and the GitHub API over HTTPS. An allowed API can also write data.
modules.expected_breakage_if_omitted: git clone/fetch/push and gh fail inside the session.
test_recipe: moat-launch --profile coding-session -- git ls-remote https://github.com/robzilla1738/moat  # expect success
moat-launch --profile coding-session -- curl -sS https://example.com  # expect refusal
check the spool: flow decision allowed by pack rule coding/repository

modules.name: Package acquisition (npm)
modules.rationale: Dependency downloads. Download and publish share registry.npmjs.org; publication is not separately enforced.
modules.expected_breakage_if_omitted: npm install fails inside the session; lockfile installs too.
test_recipe: moat-launch --profile coding-session -- npm view left-pad version  # expect success
remove the module, re-run: expect refusal and a blocked incident

modules.name: Selected model API (Anthropic)
modules.rationale: The model API the agent uses. Separate from repository and packages so it can be dropped for offline work.
modules.expected_breakage_if_omitted: the coding agent cannot reach its model.
test_recipe: moat-launch --profile coding-session -- curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.anthropic.com/  # expect a TLS answer (any HTTP code)
